errors.text_span: показва диапазон от стойности от 11000 до 15000 лева
errors.evidence: The description states the values on the y-axis are in "leva" (лева), but the axis label is "Хиляди лева" (Thousands of leva). This fundamental error in interpreting the unit makes all subsequent numerical claims incorrect by a factor of 1000. This error is repeated for all reported values.
The bar for the year 2018 is visibly above the 14,500 line, closer to 14,600. Describing it as "about 14,500" is an understatement.

The bar for 2022 is significantly higher than 12,000. It is approximately at the 12,300 or 12,400 level, which is much closer to 12,500 than to 12,000. This is a large and misleading underestimation of the value.
